competitive_landscape: Kapetan Luka (Krilo) and Jadrolinija run dense seasonal catamaran service plus heavy water-taxi tender traffic to the Pakleni — clear demand proof. All diesel; no zero-emission foiling option. The protected channels and short legs favour all-electric foiling.

summary: Hvar Town is the social and charter centre of Central Dalmatia: a packed summer superyacht anchorage fronted by the Pakleni Islands, a string of tiny pine-covered islets a few minutes offshore that absorb the day-trip and beach-club traffic. It sits in the middle of Croatia's dense island lattice — short hops to Split, Brač, Vis and Korčula — and Croatia's 226 nautical-tourism ports and top-tier yachting status give it a deep demand base. The Pakleni shuttle and inter-island legs are all well inside Pioneer II range, and the protected channels make for calm, reliable, premium-priced operation. Hvar is the natural glamour node of the Dalmatian marquee chain anchored on Split.
tagline: The glamour hub of the Dalmatian chain — Pakleni day-hops, superyacht anchorage, and dense short legs to Split, Brač, Korčula and Vis.
